perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Accuracy. Precision(684) Stasis Combat Bow Primary Ammo. "There is truly not a lot that is exciting about Raconteur except for it being a Stasis bow for the new combat mod suite and being able to double dip into any of your stasis subclass of your choice."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Draw Time. Precision(684) Stasis Combat Bow Primary Ammo. "In PvP you can definitely make this bow work. It is a precision frame for allowing bow blinting but doesn’t have a lot to really bump up Raconteur by itself. You can roll Gutshot Straight to make the bodyshot damage go up and pair it with a 120 hand cannon to body shot with the bow and headshot with the 120. Archer’s Tempo is helpful if you lane with Raconteur. Entirely up to you how you want to shape this bow, it’s underwhelming at but usable at worst."

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 55 (https://open.spotify.com/show/36OTFinErCUBrCzu6BaYbo) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE roll for end-game activities. Shapeable. Our first Stasis Precision Bow, with competitive stats by comparison with the other kinetic slot options, although Accuracy is the lowest of all the Precisions. Your aim with the Bowstring and Arrow, as ever, is to reduce the draw time, while not harming your accuracy or handling. Elastic String is the best for as low a draw time as possible and helps Handling too, at the cost of Accuracy, which you can recover with an Accuracy Masterwork, while Compact Arrow Shaft boosts handling and reload speed. Don't forget, the Noble Deeds origin perk will also boost both as well. If you ever see Archer's Tempo as the support perk in the first trait column then you don't need to look much further. Similarly, Explosive Head adds damage (and flinch) for free so is the best signature perk in the second trait column. Recommended MW: Accuracy or Draw Time, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod

Your aim with the Bowstring and Arrow, as ever, is to reduce the draw time, while not harming your accuracy or handling. Elastic String is the best for as low a draw time as possible and helps Handling too, at the cost of Accuracy, which you can recover with an Accuracy Masterwork, while Compact Arrow Shaft boosts handling and reload speed. To pair with your Stasis aspects and fragments, Headstone is your choice for signature perk in the second trait column. Datto (PvE, MKB): "Unsurprisingly, the favorite here is still Archer's Tempo. [...] I don't think there's anything in the 1st column besides maybe Stats for All that I care about whatsoever. Maybe Wellspring. Shoot to Loot is definitely an option for you Master and GM content runners though, more of a specialty thing, not really needed for general content. In the second column, Explosive Head for that PvE damage bump is pretty solid, along with Headstone for any sort of Stasis builds that you might wanna be using if you are not using Ager's Scepter or Verglas Curve the new season 20 bow for whatever reasons. Are things like Rampage and Successful Warm-up also ok, of course they are, they are totally reasonable perks to use as well. But the roll I'm looking for here would be Archer's and Explosive, unless I'm running Stasis where I want Headstone. Go for some form of Arrow Shaft and Tactile or Agile string, draw time masterwork is fine."
